references.text: The warning not to turn aside to the right or to the left from God's commands is repeated here, emphasizing the importance of obedience to the Lord's instructions.
The same language about not turning aside to the right or to the left from the commandments is linked with blessings for obedience.
Joshua receives the same exhortation not to turn aside to the right or to the left from the law, with a promise of success.
Joshua exhorts the people using the same expression to hold fast to the law of Moses without turning aside in any direction.
The warning not to turn aside to the right or to the left is used in wisdom literature regarding staying on the path of righteousness.
The promise of a long reign for David and his descendants through faithful obedience to the Lord's commands.
The Lord promises Solomon a long life if he walks in God's ways and keeps His commandments.
King Uzziah became proud when he grew powerful, an example of what happens when a king exalts himself above others.
Pride leads to downfall - a wisdom saying that highlights the warning against the king's heart becoming exalted.
